cases.construction: Twelve 4D vectors. Seed SplitMix64 state=0xC011_0000_0000_0001; each draw advances state with wrapping +=0x9E3779B97F4A7C15, then z=(z^(z>>30)) wrapping-multiplied by 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9, z=(z^(z>>27)) wrapping-multiplied by 0x94D049BB133111EB, and returns z^(z>>31). Map each result to signed uniform 2*Double(result>>11)/9007199254740992-1. Loop order is group outer 0..<3, row inner 0..<4, coordinate inner 0..<4. Each coordinate is the one-hot group center plus 0.01 times its next signed-uniform draw. Normalize each row explicitly in Double precision by its L2 norm.
cases.name: separated-groups

cases.construction: Four analytic deterministic 2D unit vectors [cos(a),sin(a)] for angles [0,0.31,0.62,0.93] radians; no random draws. Adjacent chord lengths are below the configured 0.6 cut while the endpoint chord exceeds it, creating a near-threshold neighbor chain that can behave differently under centroid linkage than single linkage.
cases.name: angular-chain

cases.construction: Four 4D unit vectors in two orthogonal coordinate planes. Pair 0/1 is [1,0,0,0] and [c,s,0,0], where c=1-(0.5999^2)/2 and s=sqrt(1-c^2), giving chord 0.5999. Pair 2/3 is [0,0,1,0] and [0,0,c2,s2], where c2=1-(0.6001^2)/2 and s2=sqrt(1-c2^2), giving chord 0.6001. Orthogonal planes separate the pairs.
cases.name: threshold-pairs

cases.construction: Three analytic unit 3D points from scalene chord distances d01=0.62, d02=0.63, d12=0.64: v0=[1,0,0]; x1=1-d01^2/2, y1=sqrt(1-x1^2), v1=[x1,y1,0]; x2=1-d02^2/2, y2=(1-d12^2/2-x1*x2)/y1, z2=sqrt(1-x2^2-y2^2), v2=[x2,y2,z2]. Recompute distances with Double scalar squares from the actual stored coordinates: the unique first pair is 0/1, all three leaf distances exceed 0.6, but the centroid ([v0+v1]/2)-to-v2 root distance is below both 0.6 and the first merge distance. A monotone maximum-descendant-height cut at 0.6 would accept no merge and yield [0,1,2]. FluidAudio confirmation is required to be exactly [0,0,0]; this is an analytic witness, not guessed linkage data. AHCClustering.swift:150-188 starts its cut traversal at the root and accepts a node whose distance is within threshold despite the descendant-height inversion.
cases.name: centroid-inversion

cases.construction: One analytic 2D unit vector [1,0]; no random draws.
cases.name: singleton

cases.construction: Three analytic 2D unit vectors [sqrt(0.75),0.5], [1,0], [sqrt(0.75),-0.5], in that row order; no random draws. Labels are recorded only from the FluidAudio oracle because tie handling is intentionally not guessed.

cases.construction: Four analytic 2D unit vectors [1,0], [0,1], [1,0], [0,1] in that row order; no random draws.

cases.construction: Forty-eight 256D vectors. Seed SplitMix64 state=0xC011_0000_0000_0008; one stream advances for every jitter draw. metadata.comparisonRule: Every expectedLabels vector is obtained exclusively by calling FluidAudio AHCClustering().cluster(embeddingFeatures:threshold:) with the validated config.clustering.threshold (0.6). Exact assertions are used for specified cases; tied-neighbors and stress-00 through stress-23 retain oracle-only labels while requiring matching point count and contiguous first-seen labels. Features are float64 tensors [points,dimensions], with their little-endian IEEE-754 bit payload compared byte-for-byte through the canonical generated JSON. The inversion witness is recomputed from stored vector coordinates using Double scalar squares and must agree within 1e-12; monotoneLabels is the exact comparison label vector [0,1,2]. All other fields and metadata compare exactly; no portable output or inferred linkage values are used.
metadata.inputConstruction: Thirty-six deterministic cases in fixed order: separated-groups, angular-chain, threshold-pairs, centroid-inversion; singleton, two-merge, two-no-merge, all-merge, no-merge, tied-neighbors, tied-duplicates, realistic-256d; stress-00 through stress-23. The original four constructions are unchanged. All rows are validated finite, nonzero, dimension-consistent, and unit L2 norm within 1e-12. The original randomized case uses SplitMix64 seed 0xC011_0000_0000_0001 and group/row/coordinate loop nesting; realistic-256d uses seed 0xC011_0000_0000_0008, with 8 groups outer, 6 rows per group, and 256 coordinates inner, one-hot group centers plus 0.025 times each next signed-uniform draw, then explicit Double L2 normalization. Both use the SplitMix64 transition and signed-uniform mapping documented on the original case. The 24 stress cases share one SplitMix64 stream seeded 0xC011_0000_0000_0010 across all cases in increasing case index; for each of 8 rows, draw angle jitter then elevation jitter, use angle=0.4*(row%4)+0.04*draw and elevation=0.12*draw in [cos(angle)*cos(elevation),sin(angle)*cos(elevation),sin(elevation)], normalize explicitly, and reverse row order for odd case indices. The added analytic cases and randomized formulas are documented in each case's construction.
